subject: Math
question:
Assume that in the course of solving a transportation problem, the following initial feasible solution is computed: How would you progress further to find the optimal solution? Use the stepping stone method.
<image 1>

options.A: Introduce a very large amount in one of the zero boxes and calculate the total shipping cost.
options.B: Introduce a very small amount in one of the zero boxes and calculate the total shipping cost.
options.C: Consider only the indirect routes for shipment, ignoring the direct routes.
options.D: Assign a value of zero to the box with the smallest cost.
options.E: Increase the cost of the most expensive route to make other routes more viable.
options.F: Assign a value of zero to the box with the d entry in the final solution if it's still present.
options.G: Consider only the direct routes for shipment, ignoring the indirect routes.
options.H: Remove the highest cost box to simplify the solution.
options.I: Assign a value of one to the box with the highest cost.
options.J: Remove all the zero boxes to simplify the solution.
